python3 -c 'import json, os, sys
from pathlib import Path
p=json.load(sys.stdin)
roots=p.get("workspace_roots") or p.get("workspacePaths") or []
if p.get("cwd"): roots=[p["cwd"]]+roots
roots=list(roots)+[os.getcwd()]
found=None
for value in roots:
    start=Path(value).resolve()
    for root in [start,*start.parents]:
        state=root/".studio-os/central.json"
        if state.is_file() and not state.is_symlink() and not state.parent.is_symlink():
            data=json.loads(state.read_text())
            if data.get("project")=='"'"'kidguard-org'"'"' and data.get("version") in (2,3) and not Path(data["source"]).is_absolute():
                found=(root,(root/data["source"]).resolve())
                break
    if found: break
if found is None: raise SystemExit("Studio OS: no matching portable project binding")
sys.path.insert(0,str(found[1]))
from studio_os.startup import entry
raise SystemExit(entry(found[0],'"'"'codex'"'"',p))
'
